exactSubmittedPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Output ONE OPAQUE black-and-white foreground luminance COVERAGE MASK from this exact primary-approved 1536×1024 Tomori TIME-ONLY NIGHT complete mother. ONLY this untouched clean mother is supplied; no prior mask, markup, composite or screenshot. Keep EVERY original subject coordinate and the exact full canvas. Do not redraw anatomy, enlarge/erode/shrink, zoom, crop, center, resize or invent any shape.

Make the ENTIRE seated girl and all her held pencil and open notebook solid pure WHITE, featureless. Every original fine short hair strand, face/head/ears/neck, blazer/shirt/collar/skirt/outer hem, arms/wrists/hands/fingers, entire pencil from visible upper end to page tip, whole open notebook including spine and thin dark lower cover, entire lap/thighs/knees/long socks, BOTH COMPLETE black loafers including toes, upper side rims, sides, full outsoles and heels are filled WHITE. Fill all internal face, clothes, finger, book, shoe seam and shaded detail WHITE. No internal black/gray marks. Especially preserve EVERY actual dark pixel along the front shoe's LEFT-facing sloping outer contour at approximately x865..940,y825..880: the mask must cover the real shoe edge continuously, NOT leave a one-pixel black crack/erosion along that contour. Fully cover both entire shoes to their actual outside outlines. Neither selected shoe includes a ring of floor.

One narrowly authorized fixed INCLUDED detail: the tiny fully enclosed original-curtain slit between arm and blazer, only around x1010,y470, is filled WHITE with surrounding person so the unchanged source RGB retains that 1–3pixel internal curtain material. This is for fixed original position only, not an independently transparent or movable person. Do not extend this exception to ANY outside space or broad curtain area. The actual outside spaces between hair strands and between legs remain BLACK.

EVERY other source surface BLACK: all room/curtains/lamp/plants/desk/table/linen/pillows/blanket/floor/rug and all independent cushion/floor contact or cast shadows. Gray only at original external antialiased silhouette edge, never inside person/shoes/book. No threshold-looking eaten edges, new outline, floor ring, rectangle, checker, text, RGB or transparency. The final source RGB will be drawn ONCE under MAX(this F, existing source-local receiver S); this mask is coverage only. EXACT1536×1024.
